description: This file provides an API for managing services and instances via procd, including functions for opening/closing services and instances, setting parameters, controlling service state, and handling triggers. It also includes utility functions for validation, signal handling, and mDNS service advertisement.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service message with optional script.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Adds an instance to the current service.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a service or its instance is running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a service or its instance.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Gets the current status of a service or instance.

methods.name: procd_open_data
methods.description: Opens a data object for a service.

methods.name: procd_set_config_changed
methods.description: Notifies that configuration has changed for a package.

methods.name: uci_load_validate
methods.description: Validates and optionally runs a callback for a config section.
